title: verify_vacancy_active DB error bypasses the archived-vacancy guard in run_action_with_prechecks
detail: verify_vacancy_active returns Result, so the `_ -> action()` catch-all includes Error: a transient DB blip skips the 422 archive guard and runs the mutation. handle_open splits this exact call as Error to 500 to prevent precisely this bypass.
recommended_fix: Mirror handle_open's three-way split: `Ok([row]) if not archived -> action()`, `Ok(_) -> 404`, `Error(_) -> 500`.

title: create_skipped_slot re-read swallows find_live_row_for_slot DB errors into a 409
evidence:
Ok(False) ->
          case find_live_row_for_slot(config.db, app_uuid, slot) {
            Ok(Some(row)) if row.status == "skipped" ->
              json_ok(json.object([#("skipped", json.bool(True))]))
            _ ->
              response_helpers.json_error(
                error_code.Conflict,
                "This reference changed state. Refresh and try again.",
                409,
              )
          }
detail: On a 0-row insert conflict the re-read's `_` arm maps a genuine find_live_row_for_slot Error to 409 Conflict, so a server fault is reported to the client as a state-change race.
recommended_fix: Add `Error(_) -> 500` before the `_ -> 409` catch-all so a DB failure is not misclassified as a conflict.
